name: application-filters
title: Filters
description: Collapsible sidebar filter panels for narrowing lists and search results by category, attribute, or range.
useWhen: A list, table, or product grid has multiple facets users need to narrow simultaneously.
Building a search results page with category, price range, or attribute refinements.
Adding a side panel to a dashboard that lets users control which data appears in view.
avoidWhen: There is only one filter dimension — use a single select or toggle instead.
The filtered list updates in real time and filter state needs to be persistent across navigation — consider URL-based filter state.
Mobile screen space is too constrained — consider a modal or bottom sheet filter drawer instead of a sidebar.
responsiveBehavior: Filter panels collapse to a hidden drawer or modal on small viewports. Use a filter toggle button to show/hide on mobile.
accessibility: Native <details> and <summary> elements provide keyboard-accessible collapsible sections without JavaScript.
Each filter input must have an associated visible label.
Announce the updated result count to screen readers via an aria-live region after filters are applied.

variants.title: Dropdown
variants.description: Single collapsible filter section using a native disclosure element, suitable for one prominent filter category.
accessibility: Native <details>/<summary> provides keyboard toggle without custom ARIA; filter inputs need linked labels.

variants.title: Dropdown (Dark)
variants.description: Single collapsible filter section adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark summary and input colors must maintain WCAG AA contrast in both open and closed states.

variants.title: Accordion
variants.description: Multi-section filter panel where each category is independently collapsible, suitable for faceted search sidebars.
accessibility: Each <details>/<summary> pair independently manages its open state; group filters in a <fieldset> per category.

variants.title: Accordion (Dark)
variants.description: Multi-section collapsible filter panel adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark section header and input colors must maintain readable contrast in expanded and collapsed states.
